Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

**Staff Data Scientist -  Experimentation & Measurement**

**Overview:**

As a Staff Data Scientist on the Decision Science team at PlayStation, you will take a leading role in designing and interpreting experiments that evaluate the impact of key initiatives and programs. You’ll help shape how millions of players around the world experience PlayStation by bringing statistical rigor, clear measurement strategies, and deep causal inference expertise to some of the most critical initiatives across the company. This highly visible role will advance our experimentation practices and ensure that data-driven insights inform the way we build, market, and evolve our products.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Design, execute, and interpret A/B tests and quasi-experiments, and apply advanced causal inference methods when experimentation isn’t feasible.
* Partner with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, marketing) to embed experimentation into development and iteration cycles and communicate results with the company’s senior leadership.
* Mentor and guide other Data Scientists, providing thought leadership and technical direction.
* Serve as a thought leader on best practices for hypothesis development, metric selection, test structure, and results communication.
* Help define and contribute to centralized experimentation frameworks, tools, and documentation to scale best practices across the company.
* Independently extract, transform, and analyze data from complex systems using SQL, Python, and other analytics tools.
* Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping drive business decisions with rigor and clarity.
* Stay current on new methodologies in experimentation and causal analysis, and bring fresh perspectives to the team’s work.
* Your insights will directly influence how PlayStation builds, markets, and evolves products across our ecosystem.

**asic Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
* 6+ years of experience in a data science experimentation/causal inference-focused role (4+ with PhD).
* Deep expertise in A/B testing and causal inference, including quasi-experimental methods.
* Proficiency in SQL and Python for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
* Broad and applied knowledge of statistical techniques.
* Experience with machine learning modeling is a plus.
* Proven ability to influence product and business decisions through clear, actionable insights.
* Experience contributing to or developing experimentation frameworks, best practices, or internal tooling.

About Scribe

Scribe https://scribe.com is where exceptional people come to do the best work of their careers. More than 94% of the Fortune 500 use Scribe to own their specialized intelligence: the unique way their teams work, decide, and get things done. Our Specialized Intelligence platform automatically captures how work happens and turns it into a living asset for people and AI agents.

We're growing fast. Since our founding in 2019, we've reached 7 million users across 600,000 businesses. Based in San Francisco, we're a LinkedIn Top Startup, valued at over $1B, and backed by leading investors. Join us in our mission to transform how people work.

tl;dr – Why this role matters

At Scribe, data is the foundation of how we make decisions — we take it very seriously. With 7M+ users and a fast-growing self-serve business, our product team ships quickly and needs to know what’s working, for whom, and why. We’re looking for our first product data scientist to answer our most important questions about how customers use Scribe, bring rigor to how we experiment, and lay the foundation of product data science that will shape the next generation of product investments.

Hiring Manager: Melanie Herscher https://www.linkedin.com/in/melanie-herscher-2757a997/, Head of Data

About the role

As the first Senior Data Scientist for Product, you’ll partner with our product, design, and engineering teams to understand user behavior, identify opportunities, and measure the impact of what we build. Reporting directly to the Head of Data, you’ll define how Scribe approaches product analytics and experimentation, and set the standards that future data scientists will build on. From day one, you’ll also have the opportunity to mentor members of the data team and raise the bar for analytical rigor across Scribe.

This role is highly visible, working directly with executive leadership as well as the product managers and engineers who own each area of the product. You will transform raw data from Scribe’s 5M+ users into clear, actionable insights, and your work will be central to how we grow our self-serve business and decide where to invest next.

Key responsibilities of this role include:

- Partner with product teams to drive insights, identifying opportunities and understanding user behavior, engagement, retention, and long-term trends across the Scribe product.

- Own experimentation at Scribe by designing and analyzing experiments, and developing and socializing a rigorous culture of experimentation throughout the company.

- Lead with hypotheses, developing and testing them with data rather than only looking for patterns in the data already in front of us.

- Define and monitor key product metrics through consistent tracking, KPIs, and dashboards, and produce new datasets that unlock business opportunities.

- Play a foundational role in building product data culture at Scribe through reproducible work, improved processes, and better tooling.

- Help shape the team as it grows, with the opportunity to mentor teammates on statistics, experimentation, and analytical best practices.

What makes you a great fit

You’d be a great fit for this role if this sounds like you:

- Have 8+ years of experience as a data scientist or data analyst with significant time partnering with product teams on products that customers love

- Strong knowledge of statistics and experimental design, with hands-on experience running A/B tests and making sound calls when experiments aren’t possible

- Strong technical proficiency in our tech stack – Snowflake, Sigma, Mixpanel, dbt cloud, and Looker – with expert SQL and fluency in Python or R

- Customer mindset, adept at balancing quantitative data with qualitative insights to drive product decisions, and an excellent storyteller in writing and visualizations

- Low ego. You care about building things and recognize that this may require rolling your sleeves up, getting in the trenches, and owning everything from instrumentation to analysis

- Proactive, high-output orientation. You push insights and data onto teams rather than waiting for requests to emerge from them

- Outcomes over output. You thrive on creating business value and know when to run a rigorous experiment v/s doing ugly napkin math to bias towards action

- Experience building technical and semantic infrastructure to power internal natural language agents and agentic automation

Bonus Points

- Experience working in high-paced Enterprise SaaS startups, with a strong self-serve motion

- Experience as the first or founding data scientist on a product team

- Experience creating a step-function change in a product team’s decision-making with the help of AI tooling

- Experience deploying machine learning models in Production

- Experience mentoring analysts or data scientists

Benefits

- Healthcare Coverage – Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including two $0/month medical plan options for employees

- Equity – Ownership in what we're building

- 401(k) Plan – through Vestwell

- Flex Benefit – $500/year for home office equipment, productivity tools, learning & development or fitness/wellness

- Commuter Benefits – $100/month for SF based employees

- PTO – Flexible paid time off and company holidays

- Parental Leave – Paid leave to support growing families

- Wellness & Family Support – Free Talkspace membership, One Medical access (location-dependent), and Kindbody discounts for family planning

At Scribe, we celebrate our differences and are committed to creating a workplace where all employees feel supported and empowered to do their best work. Scribe is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our Worker Privacy notice can be found here https://scribe.com/legal/worker-privacy.

## **Company Description**

Air is the leader in Enterprise Readiness. Our mission is to establish readiness as a real-time condition that is continuously achieved. Today, a dangerous Readiness Gap exists between what the front line needs and what is delivered. Our AI-native platform, Air Enterprise Readiness, aligns development, production, delivery, and sustainment into one coordinated execution system for government agencies and industrial suppliers. By revealing true capacity, exposing real constraints, coordinating resources, and executing at the speed of operational demands, the front line gets what it needs to succeed.

## **Job Description**

We are seeking an exceptional Data Science leader to technically lead and own major areas of Air’s core AI and Data Science, advancing the modeling, algorithms, and scientific foundations that power our products, including the data science behind Enterprise Readiness. This role will develop foundational AI capabilities that become core building blocks of Air’s products and can be leveraged by Forward Deployed Data Science teams across dozens of deployments and clients.

This leader will set the strategic direction for Core Data Science and Applied AI, identify and prioritize high-impact technical opportunities, and drive the development of reusable modeling capabilities. The role will own the end-to-end Data Science lifecycle, from problem formulation and model development and training through evaluation and validation in real-world, end-to-end use cases. We are seeking a leader who can combine deep technical expertise with strong organizational leadership to build a high-impact core science function and translate advanced Data Science into capabilities that scale across the company.

In order to do this job well, you should have a broad foundation across Data Science and deep expertise in one or more core areas such as optimization, simulation, forecasting, reinforcement learning, causal inference, or foundation modeling. You should be able to lead large-scale Data Science initiatives end to end, from identifying opportunities and working directly with clients, through partnering with Forward Deployed Data Science teams to understand their needs, to model development, evaluation, and deployment aligned with client outcomes. You should be comfortable leading cross-functional efforts spanning Data Science, platforms, Agentic AI, and data engineering, bringing together diverse technical disciplines to solve complex problems. You will also drive the scientific roadmap for the areas you own, establish technical direction and best practices, and mentor and develop other Data Scientists to build deep expertise and advance the organization’s scientific capabilities.

This role is a full-time position located out of our office in Arlington, VA / Pittsburgh, PA /  San Francisco, CA.

This role may require up to 10% travel.

### Scope of Responsibilities

* Lead Core Data Science Strategy: Define and drive the technical roadmap for core Data Science capabilities, translating complex client and business challenges into scalable data science and Applied AI across the Air Enterprise readiness.
* Set Scientific Standards and Drive Innovation: Establish best practices for model architecture, experimentation, evaluation, and deployment; assess emerging research and technologies; and translate scientific advances into robust, cost-effective, production-ready capabilities.

* Build Scalable Decision Intelligence Platforms: Working together with MLOps team, guide the development of reusable modeling capabilities that integrate with data platforms, Agentic AI systems, and client workflows to power complex decision intelligence solutions across diverse defense use cases.
* Drive Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Align Data Science, Applied AI, Forward Deployed Data Science, Product, Platform, and Engineering teams on scientific priorities, technical architecture, project execution, and evaluation criteria tied to client and product objectives.
* Develop Talent and Organizational Excellence: Mentor and develop Data Scientists across experience levels, foster deep expertise in core scientific disciplines, and cultivate a culture of technical excellence, rigorous experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

### Qualifications

* U.S. Citizenship is required

**Required Skills:**

* 7+ years of experience in Data Science or Applied AI, with a proven track record of leading large-scale, company-wide Data Science initiatives from ideation to production and delivering significant impact on products and business outcomes.
* Broad understanding of Data Science foundations, with deep expertise in one or more core areas such as optimization, simulation, reinforcement learning, forecasting, causal inference, computer vision, natural language processing, decision science, or foundation model training.
* Proven ability to lead complex Data Science projects end to end, define scientific roadmaps, establish technical direction, and drive execution from problem formulation and model development through evaluation and production deployment.
* Strong understanding of AI system architectures and internals, including agentic systems, with the ability to design and implement customized, scalable, and highly optimized solutions.
* Experience with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code to accelerate development, improve engineering productivity, and scale the delivery capacity of Data Science and Applied AI teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving Data Science, AI Research, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Platform, and Product teams, translating product requirements into technical roadmaps, robust architectures, and production-ready solutions integrated with client data platforms and workflows.
* Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to align AI strategy with client and business needs, drive timely delivery, mentor and develop Data Scientists, and promote technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning across the organization.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy across organizational boundaries, build alignment among senior technical and product stakeholders, and establish standards adopted across multiple teams.

**Desired Skills:**

* Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship
* Experience in or exposure to the nuances of a startup or other entrepreneurial environment
* Experience building and scaling reusable Data Science capabilities and modeling platforms that support multiple products, clients, and deployment environments.
* Experience designing and evaluating agentic AI systems, including tool use, orchestration, long-horizon execution, retrieval, and integration with specialized models and analytical tools.
* Familiarity with modern AI research and development practices, including foundation model adaptation, synthetic data generation, reinforcement learning, and systematic model evaluation.
* Experience developing robust experimentation and evaluation frameworks that measure model quality, system reliability, and impact on end-to-end client outcomes.
* Experience working with complex enterprise or government datasets, particularly in defense, logistics, supply chain, sustainment, acquisition, or other domains involving high-stakes decisions and operational constraints.

We firmly believe that past performance is the best indicator of future performance.  If you thrive while building solutions to complex problems, are a self-starter, and are passionate about making an impact in global security, we’re eager to hear from you.

**Air is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans status or any other characteristic protected by law.**

**About Moloco:**

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. [**Moloco Ads**](https://www.moloco.com/moloco-ads) is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. [**Moloco Commerce Media**](https://www.moloco.com/moloco-commerce-media) is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by **CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture)**, the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. **Come build what's next.**

**The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco:**

[Moloco Commerce Media (MCM)](https://www.moloco.com/solutions/moloco-commerce-media) enables marketplaces to leverage recent advances in AI to deliver highly relevant ads powered by first-party data. MCM has established strong product-market fit and is a key growth engine for Moloco as we expand our footprint with leading global and regional commerce platforms.

As a **Data Scientist** on the MCM Data Science team, you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Go-To-Market teams to shape how MCM defines success, evaluates what it ships, and decides where to invest next. You will work alongside product managers from the earliest stages of a new capability through experimentation, readout, and the decisions that follow. Your work will directly inform which features MCM builds, how we know they work, and how we communicate their value to leadership and marketplace partners.

**The Opportunity:**

In this role, you will:

* **Partner with Product on strategy:** Act as an independent thought partner to product managers, proactively surfacing opportunities, sizing them with data, and informing roadmap prioritization. You will bring your own point of view on what to build and why.
* **Define success metrics for new product initiatives:** Establish how MCM measures new capabilities, including north star and guardrail metrics, the trade-offs they encode, and the thresholds that guide ramp decisions. Align Product and Engineering on these frameworks before launch.
* **Drive evaluation and experimentation:** Design experiments and evaluation methodologies for product launches, including cases where standard A/B testing is insufficient. Analyze results rigorously and translate them into clear ship, iterate, or stop recommendations.
* **Conduct deep-dive analyses:** Use large-scale data across our ad-tech stack (ranking, retrieval, bidding, pacing) to understand how product changes affect advertiser outcomes and marketplace dynamics, and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
* **Communicate insights clearly:** Distill complex analyses into narratives that product, engineering, and non-technical stakeholders can act on. Deliver launch readouts and contribute the data narrative to product reviews.
* **Uphold data science excellence:** Apply best practices in analysis, modeling, and experimentation, and contribute to a strong data culture within the MCM team.

**How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?**

* You want to **shape products, not just measure them**, and are comfortable speaking up when the data disagrees with the plan.
* You **operate independently in ambiguity**, turning an open-ended product question into a structured analytical plan without waiting for a spec.
* You are energized by **fast-moving, early-stage product work**, where metrics do not yet exist and evaluation methods have to be invented.
* You are a **strong collaborator** who builds trust with product, engineering, and commercial stakeholders.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of industry experience in data science, analytics, or a related field (or an advanced degree with equivalent applied experience).
* Bachelor's, Master's and/or PhD in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Mathematics, etc.).
* Experience partnering with product or business stakeholders: a track record of defining success metrics, running experiments, and influencing decisions with data.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience analyzing large-scale datasets.
* Solid foundation in statistics, including experimental design, hypothesis testing, and various statistical analysis techniques such as regression.
* Excellent communication skills with experience presenting technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively in a global, cross-functional organization.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in ad-tech, marketplace, or e-commerce environments (specifically bidding, ranking, or auction logic).
* Experience evaluating machine learning or AI-driven systems in production, including offline evaluation, online experimentation, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Familiarity with causal inference methods or evaluation approaches for products where standard A/B testing does not apply.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and stakeholders.

**Compensation & Benefits**

U.S.-based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and well-being benefits and perks. U.S.-based employees also receive up to 12 scheduled paid holidays per calendar year and one Thrive Day off per quarter. Additionally, all employees have Flexible Time Off (FTO).

The successful candidate may be eligible for a bonus and equity awards. Eligibility and amounts are determined by performance and the terms of the applicable plans.

The location for this role is listed above. For base pay range purposes, location-based compensation is grouped into the following regions. Your region is determined by your assigned work location.

* **Region A:** Menlo Park Office, New York Office, SF Bay Area, New York Metro Area
* **Region B:** Seattle Office, Seattle, Los Angeles/Orange County, San Diego, Austin, Boston, Washington DC Metro Area, Miami
* **Region C:** All other U.S. locations

**Salary Ranges:**

Region A:

$148,000—$180,000 USD

Region B:

$133,200—$165,000 USD

Region C:

$125,800—$157,250 USD

**Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:**

Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.

**Moloco Values:**

* **Lead with Humility:** Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.
* **Uncapped Growth Mindset:** We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Create Real Value:** We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.
* **Go Further Together:** We’re one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.

**Additional Resources:**

* [Moloco Company Blog](https://www.moloco.com/blogs)
* [Moloco Leadership](https://www.moloco.com/company/leadership)
* [Moloco Newsroom](https://www.moloco.com/newsroom)

**AI Use in Interviews**

Our interview process is designed to get to know the real you. Unless a round specifically includes AI as part of what's being assessed, we ask that candidates engage without AI assistance. Please review our [AI Use in Interviews Policy](https://www.moloco.cloud/hubfs/careers/AI%20Use%20in%20Interviews.pdf) before your interview to understand what to expect. Failure to comply with this policy may impact your candidacy.

**Candidate Privacy Notice:**

We approach projects that have the aspiration and riskiness of research with the speed and ambition of a startup.

Our team – [Bellwether](https://x.company/careers/7843266002/) – operates at the intersection of machine learning, geospatial data, and pressing issues with enterprise customers, governments, and more. We focus on severe weather manifestations of climate change, such as wildfires, and aim to use a wide range of data and analytics to better understand and predict what these events could mean for communities and businesses across the globe. We do this through the detection and classification of the features and patterns of the natural and built worlds, the application of cutting-edge machine learning, and the redesign of the full geo-ML workflow. This work extends into development and production-level work as well, as Bellwether also has a number of products that are live with customers. The result: tools and models that allow a range of industries to better leverage earth observation insights.

**About the Role:**We are looking for a **Lead Data Scientist** to build and unify the data infrastructure that powers our model training pipelines for Project Bellwether. In this role, you will lead the effort to construct a comprehensive multimodal data corpus—integrating geospatial, imagery, sensor, and operational feeds—that serves as a strategic moat for pre- and post-disaster response and resilience.  
  
Your primary focus will be designing automated ingestion pipelines for complex multimodal datasets, establishing rigorous data quality validation frameworks, and managing dataset versioning to support continuous machine learning training loops. You will bridge the gap between operations, remote annotation teams, and machine learning engineers to ensure our disaster-response models are trained on reliable, high-fidelity, and well-structured data.

* Architect and build automated ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) data pipelines to aggregate, clean, and harmonize data from disparate sources, databases, and operational ingestion flows.
* Implement DataOps practices, including data quality monitoring, automated schema validation, and anomaly detection to catch corrupt or mislabeled data early.
* Standardize and integrate third-party annotation workflows and remote labeling feeds into unified datasets ready for model training.
* Design and maintain dataset versioning and storage systems to allow reproducible machine learning experiments and seamless data retrieval.
* Partner with ML engineers and operations teams to turn geospatial, imagery, and sensor metadata into structured training features.
* Lead the end-to-end development of multimodal machine learning models, driving innovation from research and dataset architecture to production deployment for pre- and post-disaster response.

* Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize model performance, scalability, and integration into existing product workflows.
* Establish best practices for MLOps, including model versioning, automated testing, and performance tracking to ensure reliable and high-quality deployments.
* Help hire and grow the data science function, setting the technical bar and culture as the team scales.
* Design, build, and maintain robust data ontologies and taxonomies to systematically organize, categorize, and integrate complex geospatial and multimodal datasets.

* Education: Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Data Engineering & Architecture: 7+ years experience building scalable data pipelines, managing relational and non-relational databases, and unifying fragmented data storage systems.

* ML Data Lifecycle Understanding: Hands-on experience structuring datasets specifically for machine learning workflows, including handling annotations, metadata tracking, and training set curation.

* Workflow & Label Integration: Harmonize external labeling pipelines and annotation feeds into streamlined, model-ready training assets.
* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner with software engineers, data scientists, and operational stakeholders to convert complex sensor attributes into targeted features for prediction pipelines.
